# FamFlix reference facts

This local-only reference preserves the approved 25-second intro from FamFlix
commit `cc85bc1fd141451295a375216e881e825d887dd1`. It contains the video
composition and original fictional artwork, not the application's source or
database. The people and titles are illustrative.

- FamFlix has personal watchlists and shared lists for families and friends.
- A movie-night stack lets people swipe and vote together.
- People can mark titles watched, save their own score and log who watched.

The golden MP4/poster/narration are the approved delivery, not generated model
caches. Do not publish this local fixture without separate approval.
